src-tauri/Cargo.toml.content:
[package]
name = "theme-forge-nebular-fusion"
version = "0.6.1"
description = "Theme Forge Nebular Fusion native bootstrap"
edition = "2024"
rust-version = "1.98.0"
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
publish = false

[features]
test-sidecar-harness = []
native-smoke = []

[[bin]]
name = "tfsb-studio-fake-sidecar"
path = "tests/support/fake-sidecar.rs"
required-features = ["test-sidecar-harness"]

[lib]
name = "tfsb_studio_lib"
crate-type = ["lib", "cdylib", "staticlib"]

[build-dependencies]
serde_json = "=1.0.151"
tauri-build = { version = "=2.6.3", features = [] }

[dependencies]
base64 = { version = "=0.22.1", default-features = false, features = ["alloc"] }
serde = { version = "=1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "=1.0.151"
sha2 = "=0.10.9"
tauri = { version = "=2.11.5", features = [] }
tauri-plugin-dialog = { version = "=2.7.2", default-features = false, features = ["gtk3"] }
unicode-normalization = { version = "=0.1.25", default-features = false, features = ["std"] }

[lints.rust]
unsafe_code = "forbid"
missing_debug_implementations = "warn"

[lints.clippy]
dbg_macro = "deny"
todo = "deny"
unwrap_used = "deny"
expect_used = "deny"
panic = "deny"
